name: Workflow Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the workflow status of the details of a specific level.

COMP.name: Complete
COMP.definition: Level details are complete. All required data is populated and verified.

CNFL.name: Conflict
CNFL.definition: Level details are incomplete due to conflicting details from 2 or more sources.

COND.name: Conditionally Complete
COND.definition: Level details are complete pending a condition.

DLTD.name: Deleted
DLTD.definition: Level has been deleted, cancelled/deactivated/invalidated by the source or due to error processing error.
